concerns.text: Critical FR/SC coverage gap: Tasks T016 (API Collector), T018 (Data Cleaner), T020 (Abstract Fallback), T021 (Output Verification), and T022 (Blinding Logic) are marked incomplete or rejected in the 'REJECTED' section. These tasks are the sole implementation vehicles for FR-001 (API support), FR-007 (Validation), FR-009 (Abstract fallback), and Constitution Principle VI (Registry Integrity). Without these, US1 acceptance criteria (data cleaning, logging, exclusion) cannot be met.

Missing schema contracts: Task T007 (Create ALL schema contracts) is marked rejected/incomplete. This prevents FR-007 (Validate data against schema contracts) from being implemented, as the required `contracts/cleaned_study.schema.yaml` and `contracts/effect_size.schema.yaml` files are missing. This blocks the entire data pipeline.

Missing test data coverage: Tasks T015b and T015c (Mock Data Generators) are incomplete. US1 acceptance criteria explicitly require the pipeline to be 'tested by running it against a known set of mock study records'. Without these tasks, the CI/CD reproducibility requirement (SC-005) and US1 verification cannot be satisfied.

Stale/Unmapped tag: Task T033b (Blinding Bias Quantification) is introduced but not mapped to any existing Functional Requirement in spec.md. While it addresses a review concern, it represents scope creep unless explicitly authorized by an update to FR-014 or a new requirement. The task description does not reference a valid FR/SC ID.

Critical US3 coverage gap: All implementation tasks for User Story 3 (T037-T043) are marked incomplete. This leaves FR-006 (Visualization), FR-014 (Conditional logic for N<10), and Constitution Principle VII (Delivery Format Verification) without implementation tasks, rendering US3 non-functional.
